description.text: Starter Set VMAX Blastoise, a 60-card deck released on 4 December 2020 with Venusaur's, each with two copies of its Pokémon VMAX. Blastoise VMAX's Grand Falls deals 120 damage and attaches up to three Water Energy from the deck to the Bench, and G-Max Bombard deals 220 and 30 more to two Benched Pokémon. Both decks have a Boss's Orders and four Quick Ball. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide came with it. The VMAX Battle Triple Starter Set of the same day held the Charizard VMAX, Venusaur VMAX and Blastoise VMAX decks, four holo promos (Genesect, Heatran, Suicune and Lugia), its own playmat and a card box, a Christmas gift for families.
